installments.title: Installments
installments.otherLabel: Other number of installments, from {{min}} to {{max}}
installments.outOfRange: Enter a whole number of installments between {{min}} and {{max}}.
installments.rateHelp: It's on the receipt or in your bank's app. With a rate, the installment is fixed.
installments.rateRequired: Enter the effective annual rate, or choose “No interest”.
installments.rateInvalid: Enter a rate between {{min}} and {{max}}%, with up to 2 decimals.
installments.firstStatement: First installment on the statement of
installments.single: A single installment of {{amount}} on the {{month}} statement (closes {{date}}).
installments.budgetTitle: We'll raise the {{category}} budget in {{count}} months
installments.budgetBody: Each installment counts in its month's budget. So you don't go over, we add the installment to the budget of each month after the purchase. If you delete or edit the purchase, we undo it.
installments.closedMonth: An installment falls in {{month}}, which is closed. Reopen it, or change the date or the installments to save the purchase.
installments.overLimit: This purchase takes you over the limit. You can still save it.

pay.waitingRate: Waiting for the exchange rate to convert the amount…
pay.notSpending: It's a transfer: it doesn't count as spending in your budget or overview.

errors.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_INVALID: The amount must be greater than zero with up to 2 decimals.
errors.TRANSACTION_TYPE_INVALID: That transaction type does not exist.
errors.TRANSACTION_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Pick the account for the transaction.
errors.TRANSACTION_ACCOUNTS_MUST_DIFFER: The destination account must differ from the source.
errors.TRANSACTION_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: We could not find that account. Pick another one from the list.
errors.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: That account is deactivated. Pick an active account.
errors.TRANSACTION_CATEGORY_REQUIRED: Pick a category to save the transaction.
errors.TRANSACTION_CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND: That category is no longer available. Pick another one.

errors.TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH: The description can be up to {{descriptionMax}} characters.
errors.TRANSACTION_DATE_RANGE_INVALID: The date range is not valid.
errors.TRANSACTION_NOT_FOUND: We could not find that transaction.
errors.TRANSACTION_ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_UNSUPPORTED: That account uses a currency that does not allow transactions. Pick one in pesos or dollars.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_UNAVAILABLE: The exchange rate is not available right now.

errors.PERIOD_CLOSED: The month of that date is closed. Reopen it to record or change transactions.

detail.title: Transaction
detail.afterCut: The purchase was after its month's statement closed, so the first installment fell in {{month}}.
detail.budgetBody: Each installment counts in its statement month's budget. Installments after the purchase month raised their month's budget.

delete.question: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.warning: This can’t be undone: it leaves your history, balances, budgets and Summary. If it was a mistake, you’ll need to record it again.
